Callum Reid  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 callum.reid@cybershieldtech.com | 📍 Bengaluru, India  
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/callumreid | GitHub: github.com/callumreid  

A seasoned platform engineer with a proven track record of designing and scaling resilient, secure infrastructure at the intersection of cloud-native technologies and cybersecurity. Over the past eight years, I’ve led the architecture of mission-critical systems, optimized cloud spend by 35%, and mentored teams across three continents. My expertise lies in building scalable, automated platforms that balance operational efficiency with enterprise-grade security. Currently, I drive the platform strategy at CyberShield Technologies, where I architect solutions that protect high-value assets while enabling rapid innovation.  

**Professional Experience**  
At CyberShield Technologies, I oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our platform, ensuring it meets the demands of enterprise-scale cybersecurity operations. My focus has been on refining Kubernetes deployments, automating infrastructure with Terraform, and embedding observability tools like Prometheus and Grafana into our monitoring stack. I’ve also spearheaded initiatives to reduce cloud costs by 25% through resource optimization and cost-allocation strategies, while maintaining SLA compliance.  

Prior to joining CyberShield, I spent two years as a Cloud Platform Architect at CloudSafe, where I designed a hybrid cloud architecture that supported 500+ concurrent security workflows. This involved orchestrating Kubernetes clusters, integrating Serverless functions for real-time threat detection, and implementing load-balancing strategies to ensure high availability. My work there directly contributed to a 40% reduction in infrastructure downtime.  

Before that, I was a Senior SRE Engineer at NetDefend, where I led the migration of monolithic applications to microservices. This included designing scalable Kubernetes deployments, automating CI/CD pipelines, and embedding infrastructure-as-code practices into every project. I also introduced Prometheus-based monitoring to track system performance, which helped identify and resolve bottlenecks in real time.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **AWS**: Architectured multi-region cloud infrastructures, mentored teams on best practices, and optimized cost structures across three major projects.  
- **Kubernetes**: Designed and scaled production-grade clusters, implemented automated rollback mechanisms, and led the adoption of Helm for deployment management.  
- **Terraform**: Own production infrastructure-as-code systems, reducing manual configuration errors by 60% and enabling rapid environment provisioning.  
- **Cloud Cost Optimization**: Reduced monthly AWS spend by 35% through resource tagging, spot instance utilization, and automated scaling policies.  
- **Load Balancing**: Implemented NGINX-based solutions to distribute traffic across microservices, improving system responsiveness by 20%.  
- **Prometheus/Grafana**: Built centralized dashboards for real-time monitoring, enabling proactive issue resolution and reducing mean time to recovery by 15%.  
- **Serverless**: Integrated AWS Lambda for event-driven security workflows, reducing latency and improving incident response times.  
- **Infrastructure as Code**: Led the transition of legacy systems to Terraform, ensuring full version control and auditability of infrastructure changes.  
- **Network Automation**: Scripted Ansible playbooks to automate routine configuration tasks, cutting deployment cycles by 30%.  

**Education**  
Master of Science in Cybersecurity, University of Edinburgh, 2016.  

**Languages**  
English (native), Hindi (fluent), German (intermediate).

- Google Cloud Professional Architect  
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
